pages: TERM FACILITY AGREEMENT
1. Definitions. Words in this Agreement have the meanings given in this clause.

pages.text: Consolidated EBITDA means net income before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation, with add-backs for restructuring costs capped at 20% of Consolidated EBITDA.
Material Adverse Effect means any event which, in the opinion of the Lender, has a material adverse effect on the business of the Borrower.

pages: 2. Purpose. The Borrower shall apply each loan towards its general working capital.
3. Interest. Interest accrues daily at the rate stated in the Commitment Letter.

pages.text: 4. Change of Control. On a change of control of the Borrower, the Lender may cancel the Facility and declare all loans immediately due.
5. Cross-Default. Any failure by the Borrower to pay other financial indebtedness when due is an Event of Default, with no minimum amount.
6. Termination. The Lender may terminate this Agreement on any Event of Default without giving a remedy period.
7. Indemnity. The Borrower shall indemnify the Lender against every loss arising from this Agreement, including loss caused by the Lender.
8. Assignment. The Lender may assign its rights to any person. The Borrower may not assign its rights without the consent of the Lender.
9. Limitation of Liability. The aggregate liability of the Lender shall not exceed the fees received by it in the prior year.
10. Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by the laws of Kenya and the courts of Nairobi have jurisdiction.

pages: LOAN NOTE
A. The Lender will make the sum in the Schedule available to the Company.

pages.text: B. If any person comes to hold more than half of the voting shares in the Company, the Lender may require immediate repayment of the whole sum.
C. The Company may not pass its rights under this Note to anybody else unless the Lender first approves in writing.
D. The Lender may bring this Note to an end at any time, for no reason, on five days of written warning.
E. The Company will hold the Lender harmless from all claims, costs and losses connected with this Note.
F. The Lender is never responsible for more than the fees it has been paid during the last twelve months.
G. Non-payment by the Company of any other borrowing above USD 1,000,000 also makes the whole sum repayable.
H. A serious decline in the Company's trading position, as judged by the Lender, makes the whole sum repayable.
I. Operating earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation may include one-off costs of up to one fifth of that figure.
J. Kenyan law applies to this Note and any dispute goes before the High Court in Nairobi.

pages: COMMERCIAL LEASE
1. Premises. The Landlord lets Suite 400, Riverside Towers, to the Tenant for office use.
2. Rent. The Tenant shall pay KES 500,000 on the first day of each month.

pages.text: 3. Assignment and Subletting. The Tenant shall not assign this Lease or sublet any part of the Premises without the consent of the Landlord.
4. A merger, acquisition or transfer of a controlling interest in the Tenant is treated as an assignment needing the consent of the Landlord.
5. Termination. The Landlord may terminate this Lease if rent is unpaid for 14 days after written notice.
6. Indemnity. The Tenant shall indemnify the Landlord against third-party claims caused by the Tenant's use of the Premises.
7. Neither party is liable to the other for consequential loss, including lost profits.
8. This Lease is governed by the laws of Kenya.

pages: MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT
1. Services. The Supplier will provide the bookkeeping services set out in Schedule 1.
2. Fees. The Customer will pay each invoice within 30 days.

pages.text: 3. Either party may end this Agreement on 90 days of written notice, and at once if the other commits a material breach it fails to remedy in 30 days.
4. Each party's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim.
5. Each party will indemnify the other against third-party claims caused by its own negligence.
6. Neither party may transfer this Agreement without the other's written consent, except to an affiliate.
7. Any dispute is settled by arbitration in Nairobi under Kenyan law.

pages: OFFICE SHUTTLE NOTICE
Staff assigned to the second floor may use the morning shuttle from the Westlands bus terminal.
The route terminates at the Upper Hill stop at 8.30 each weekday.
Please read the change of shift rota, which is under the control of each team manager.
Staff working across a tax jurisdiction boundary should tell the payroll team.
Visitors are governed by the normal building security rules at the front desk.
